source.objective: C2 Codex recovery bug observed on C3 run f91ce3f175324137aba3c11128b9317b: persisted `thread/read` from a fresh app-server reports the active turn `01a0f1c8-9253-7642-ae74-9897cf2e7bc4` as `interrupted`, but the owning c2_worker remains indefinitely alive in `rpc.wait_for_turn`/poll timeout with its local receipt still phase=started and no terminal delivery. This creates zombie workers and prevents queued operational steers from being consumed. Reconciliation should periodically cross-check persisted thread/turn state (or receive a durable terminal event) and recover an interrupted turn without requiring private stdio app-server notification delivery.
